/* selectLinkInstList - Lee MS */
SELECT A.INST_NM AS LINK_INST_NM, A.ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD AS ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD, A.OGDP_INST_DTL_SE_CD AS OGDP_INST_DTL_SE_CD, DECODE(A.CMIT_MFCMM_ENTRST_YN, 'Y', '위촉', '미위촉') AS ENTRST_YN, DECODE(A.NOW_ACTVT_YN, 'Y', '예', '아니오') AS ACTVT_YN, B.INST_NM AS INST_NM, A.ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO AS ESNTL_LINK_MNG_NO FROM ACA600 A, SAA000 B /* 통합기관(B) */ WHERE A.INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND A.NOW_ACTVT_YN LIKE #{ACTVT_YN}||'%' AND NVL(A.INST_NM, ' ') LIKE '%'||#{INST_NM}||'%'
AND A.ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD IN ('1', '2')
AND A.ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD IN ('3', '4')
AND A.ESNTL_LINK_INST_SE_CD LIKE #{INST_SE}||'%'

/* selectemrgRptList - Lee MS */
SELECT A.INCDNT_OCRN_YMD AS INCDNT_OCRN_YMD, /* 사건발생일자 */ A.INCDNT_TTL_NM AS INCDNT_TTL_NM, /* 사건제목명 */ A.OCRN_RPT_YMD AS OCRN_RPT_YMD, /* 발생보고일자 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) AS PIC_NM, /* 담당자명 */ C.INST_NM AS INST_NM, /* 기관명 */
A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건대분류구분코드 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건중분류구분코드 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건소분류구분코드 */ A.INCDNT_CN AS INCDNT_CN, /* 사건내용 */ A.INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN AS INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN, /* 사건관련규모내용 */ A.PIC_NO AS PIC_NO, /* 담당자번호 */ A.INST_NO AS INST_NO, /* 기관번호 */
D.WRD_TELNO AS WRD_TELNO, /* 유선전화번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO, /* 휴대전화번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(D.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR, /* 이메일 */ E.CTPV_NM AS CTPV_NM, /* 시도명 */ E.SGG_NM AS SGG_NM, /* 시군구명 */ A.RM_CN AS RM_CN, /* 비고내용 */ A.ATFINO AS ATFINO, /* 첨부화일번호 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO /* 긴급대응사건번호 */ FROM ACA700 A, SAA000 C, SCA100 D, SAA020 E, ACA720 F /* 긴급대응보고(B), 통합기관(C), 종사자(D) 시군구코드(E) 긴급대응종결(F)*/ WHERE A.INST_NO = C.INST_NO AND C.SGG_CD = E.SGG_CD(+) AND A.PIC_NO = D.ENFSN_NO AND A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = F.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO(+) AND A.INCDNT_OCRN_YMD >= #{BGNG_YMD} AND A.INCDNT_OCRN_YMD <= #{END_YMD} AND A.INCDNT_TTL_NM LIKE #{INCDNT_TTL_NM}||'%' AND F.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO IS NULL

/* selectEmrgActnList - Lee MS */
SELECT A.INCDNT_OCRN_YMD AS INCDNT_OCRN_YMD, /* 사건발생일자 */ A.INCDNT_TTL_NM AS INCDNT_TTL_NM, /* 사건제목명 */ A.OCRN_RPT_YMD AS OCRN_RPT_YMD, /* 발생보고일자 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(D.FLNM_ENCPT) AS PIC_NM, /* 담당자명 */ C.INST_NM AS INST_NM, /* 기관명 */
A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_LCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건대분류구분코드 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_MLSFC_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건중분류구분코드 */ A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_SCLAS_SE_CD, /* 긴급대응사건소분류구분코드 */ A.INCDNT_CN AS INCDNT_CN, /* 사건내용 */ A.INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN AS INCDNT_RELATA_SCALE_CN, /* 사건관련규모내용 */ A.PIC_NO AS PIC_NO, /* 담당자번호 */ A.INST_NO AS INST_NO, /* 기관번호 */
D.WRD_TELNO AS WRD_TELNO, /* 유선전화번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(D.MBL_TELNO_ENCPT) AS MBL_TELNO, /* 휴대전화번호 */ C##RG.DEC_B64(D.EML_ADDR_ENCPT) AS EML_ADDR, /* 이메일 */ E.CTPV_NM AS CTPV_NM, /* 시도명 */ E.SGG_NM AS SGG_NM, /* 시군구명 */ A.RM_CN AS RM_CN, /* 비고내용 */ A.ATFINO AS ATFINO, /* 첨부화일번호 */
A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO AS EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO /* 긴급대응사건번호 */ FROM ACA700 A, SAA000 C, SCA100 D, SAA020 E, ACA720 F /* 긴급대응보고(B), 통합기관(C), 종사자(D) 시군구코드(E) 긴급대응종결(F)*/ WHERE A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = F.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO(+) AND A.INST_NO = C.INST_NO AND C.SGG_CD = E.SGG_CD(+) AND A.PIC_NO = D.ENFSN_NO AND A.INCDNT_OCRN_YMD >= #{BGNG_YMD} AND A.INCDNT_OCRN_YMD <= #{END_YMD} AND A.INCDNT_TTL_NM LIKE #{INCDNT_TTL_NM}||'%' AND F.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACA710 B WHERE A.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO = B.EMRG_CNTRMS_INCDNT_NO)
